Design.evidence_source: Thirty-two percent of the third parties choose to punish an egoistic dictator in the hidden information treatment, but 61% of the third parties choose to punish an egoistic dictator in the baseline treatment (see also Figure 2). This reduction of 29 percentage points or 48% is statistically signicant at the 5% level (Fisher's exact test (FET), p=0.027).
